cli:cli-machine-contract:help.stdout:
KIS-NET YTM Matrix CLI

Operations:
  history: retrieve all categories for up to 2000 dates; run ytm history --help.
  matrix: fetch YTM Matrix rows for a 기준일 and 종류.
  kinds: list accepted 종류 codes and Korean labels.
  upgrade: check or replace an official managed installation.

Accepted 종류 values:
  10 = 국채
  20 = 지방채
  30 = 특수채
  40 = 통안채
  50 = 은행채
  60 = 기타금융채
  70 = 회사채(무보증)
  80 = 회사채(사모)

Source terms are preserved where official: 기준일, 종류, and 적용대상채권.
Run ytm help <command> for command-specific input and output guidance.

CLI usage:
  ytm --version
  ytm matrix --base-date <기준일> --kind <종류> [--fallback previous-available] [--lookback-days <days>] [--format json|csv|tsv|xlsx] [--output <file.xlsx>] [--overwrite] [--pretty]
  ytm kinds [--base-date <기준일>] [--format json|csv|tsv|xlsx] [--output <file.xlsx>] [--overwrite] [--pretty]
  ytm upgrade [--check]
  ytm help <command>

Output:
  json is the default and prints one JSON object. csv and tsv print tabular success rows. xlsx requires --output <file.xlsx>, writes one workbook, and prints one JSON receipt; it replaces an existing file only with --overwrite. Command failures print one JSON object to stdout and exit non-zero, including upgrade failures. Unknown command names given to ytm help print a plain-text message and exit non-zero. Help diagnostics for invalid invocations are written to stderr.
